definitionZh: 标记 CSS 属性指将绘制在元素路径的第一个,中间,最后一个顶点上的标记;即其所有顶点. 标记必须是使用 SVG 元素定义的,只能以 URL 值来引用 。 CSS属性的值凌驾于SVG中标记启动,标记,和标记端属性的任何值.
sourceDefinition: The marker CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the first, middle, and last vertices of the element's path; that is, at all of its vertices. The marker must have been defined using an SVG element, and can only be referenced with a urlvalue value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-start, marker, and marker-end attributes in the SVG.
